Run against a reasoning model served by mistralrs on port 1234.

```python
"""Run against a reasoning model served by mistralrs on port 1234."""

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="local", base_url="http://localhost:1234/v1")

response = client.responses.create(
    model="default",
    input="What is 9 times 7? Explain your answer briefly.",
    max_output_tokens=256,
    extra_body={"reasoning_max_tokens": 64},
)

print(response.output_text)
print(response.usage)
```
